description:
Add existing zTokens as collateral on Zest Protocol v2.

Use this when you deposited directly to a vault and need to register
those zTokens as collateral for borrowing.

Note: zest_supply already handles this atomically via supply-collateral-add.
This tool is only needed if you used vault deposit separately.

Mainnet only.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

amount.description: Amount of zTokens to add as collateral (in smallest units)

asset.description: Asset symbol (e.g., 'sBTC', 'USDC') or full contract ID

name: zest_enable_collateral
